definitions.explanation: Organized learning or skill development, typically in a professional or educational context.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新入|しんにゅう}→新入：11503_shinnyuu⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧{研修|けんしゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加：02498_sanka⟧。
examples.english: To participate in new employee training.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{研修|けんしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
{研修|けんしゅう}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧3⟦{ヶ月|かげつ}→ヶ月：00956_kagetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

notes:
{研修|けんしゅう} refers to organized professional training or development. Composed of {研|けん} (polish/study) + {修|しゅう} (learn/master).

TYPES:
- ⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧{研修|けんしゅう}: new employee training
- ⟦{社内|しゃない}→社内：13731_shanai⟧{研修|けんしゅう}: in-house training
- ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧{研修|けんしゅう}: overseas training
- ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧{研修|けんしゅう}: technical training

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {研修|けんしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive training
- {研修|けんしゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加：02498_sanka⟧: to participate in training
- {研修|けんしゅう}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧: training period
